description:
Notes, documents and tasks, all local. No subscription, no telemetry.

Tisty keeps what you know on your own machine: notes, documents and tasks, in plain
Markdown files you can read without it. Everything you do is written to an append-only
log, so nothing is lost by accident and a change can be walked back; erasing something
for good is the one step that cannot. No account, no
subscription, no telemetry, no server. Sync, if you want it, goes through a folder both
your machines already reach, and an assistant can come in through a door you open.
Tisty 1.44.1
Clearer notices when you share, and your Tisty stays yours alone
- When you bring a document in and on the Shared row, each person's fingerprint is the same 20 digits that Settings › Security shows.
- A language you could only read turns editable as soon as the owner opens it to you.
- Tisty tells you which languages did not arrive, when a new edit link has to wait, and when a name only looks like that of whoever makes Tisty.
- Another person's computer in your synced folder can no longer take your Tisty over.
- Clearing Tisty's temporary files no longer asks you to confirm again a computer that was joining.
What's Changed
- docs(mcp): registries find Tisty by tasks, todo and notes, and show its README in English with setup and tools by @rgdevment in #669
- fix(sharing): a link shows each person's fingerprint in the digits Settings › Security shows by @rgdevment in #667
- fix(sharing): the Shared row lists each person's fingerprint, so the owner can check who edited by @rgdevment in #668
- docs: the assistant door is told as open everywhere, any task may be said done, and tisty serve is gone by @rgdevment in #670
- fix(sharing): a language kept to read turns editable once its owner hands out its token by @rgdevment in #671
- fix(sharing): the Shared row and a link say when a new link waits by @rgdevment in #672
- fix(sync): a machine that said its root keeps that owner, whatever da… by @rgdevment in #673
- fix(sync): the machines a folder is still taking up are kept beside the confirmed keys, not in the cache by @rgdevment in #674
- fix(sharing): reopening an edit link hands over the language tokens granted since, as Sync does by @rgdevment in #675
- docs: the 1.44.1 news tell of one fingerprint everywhere, languages the owner opens and clearer notices by @rgdevment in #676
